description:
Create a new Repository Layout in JFrog Artifactory named 'flat-org-layout'. 

Log in as admin (password: 'password'). Navigate to Administration > Repositories > Layouts and create a new layout with the following exact configuration:

- Layout Name: flat-org-layout
- Artifact Path Pattern: [org]/[module]/[baseRev]/[module]-[baseRev](-[classifier]).[ext]
- Descriptor Path Pattern: [org]/[module]/[baseRev]/[module]-[baseRev].pom
- Folder Integration Revision RegExp: SNAPSHOT
- File Integration Revision RegExp: SNAPSHOT

Leave other fields at their defaults. Save the layout.
